fields.title: Venting is a conditional load reduction, not a qualified operation
fields.finding: The 0.458903732 pressure fraction and 2645.660029 kg use the 500 m full-volume state. At sea-level ISA the same absolute differential requires 2912.791114 kg on that convention. Venting an airborne neutral hull makes it descend; it needs a supported landing/handling sequence. Regulatory speeds are analogous test criteria, not established safe hull speeds.
fields.proposed_fix: Retain the arithmetic and require explicit terrain, support, gas volume, atmosphere and valve control. Do not infer a 500 m AGL operating condition solely from a 500 m atmospheric design altitude.
